narrative_purpose: Shows the daily thermal cliff and how body size splits the response: bulk lets a large animal ignore an hour of cold outright, while a small one has to shelter.
subject: A forest clearing during total eclipse. Filling the sky above the canopy gap, the enormous unlit disc of a banded gas giant with only a thin bright rim of light around one edge. In the clearing, one very large six-limbed animal stands completely still in the open, head low, its thin head-fan folded flat against its skull. In the near foreground, four or five small slender creatures press together into a hollow between the buttress roots of a huge tree. Cold mist sinks through the canopy gap in visible downward streams around them.
scene: A rainforest clearing under total planetary eclipse, all sunlight gone, the only illumination coming from the forest's own glowing growth and from the thin rim of the eclipsing disc.
camera: Wide low establishing view from ground level, the clearing and the huge sky disc both in frame, the sheltering creatures near and the large animal mid-distance.
light: Very dim overall. A thin cold rim-light along the edge of the sky disc; faint blue-green glow from ground growth and bark; no warm light anywhere; deep shadow filling most of the frame.
palette: Void-indigo and deep teal-indigo dominant, faint cyan and living-teal glow from the forest growth, one thin cold pale rim on the sky disc, no warm accents at all.
style: Painterly atmospheric naturalist plate, mood-forward, low contrast, hand-painted texture.
detail_level: Crisp on the sinking mist streams and on the huddled small creatures; the large animal held in soft silhouette; the canopy and far trunks dissolving into dark haze.
composition: Enormous dark sky disc occupying the upper half, the still large animal on the mid-line, the huddled creatures low in the foreground third, generous dim negative space throughout.
consistency_notes: Cool Pandora palette with no warm accent whatsoever - the absence of warm light is the subject. The large animal has six limbs and a thin bony head-fan, here folded flat. Keep the sky region dark and plain for overlaid callouts.
